## bare-git-calls-rely-on-absolute-root  (invariant, verified)
Every worktree/scratch git call passes dir="" and works only because FindRepoRoot returns an absolute root, making --git-dir absolute.

- internal/worktree/*.go
- internal/scratch/*.go
- internal/git/git.go

## clone-flips-core-bare-false  (rationale, verified)
clone.Run sets core.bare=false on the .bare repo before any worktree exists, and every worktree in the layout depends on that one-time fix-up.

- internal/clone/clone.go

## default-branch-worktree-safe-only-by-omission  (invariant, verified)
gt wt list/nuke never touch the default-branch checkout only because it lives outside cfg.WorktreeTypes — no code protects it by name.

- internal/worktree/worktree.go
- internal/config/config.go
- internal/clone/clone.go

## envrc-bytes-must-not-drift  (invariant, verified)
EnvrcContent must stay byte-identical for an empty profile, because writeEnvrc decides whether to rewrite with plain string equality.

- internal/setauth/setauth.go
- internal/setauth/profile.go
- tests/setauth_test.go

## findruleset-matches-non-branch-gt-ruleset  (gotcha, verified)
findRuleset claims any ruleset named "gt" as gt's own regardless of target, so SettingsApply would PUT a branch payload over a non-branch ruleset.

- internal/repogov/settings.go

## repo-gt-yaml-template-match-ignored  (gotcha, verified)
A `match:` on a template in a repo's committed .gt.yaml validates fine and is printed in the plan, but is never applied — those templates always run.

- internal/setup/setup.go
- internal/setup/runner.go

## setup-untrusted-gate-is-plan-wide  (rationale, verified)
Plan.Untrusted is one bool for the whole plan on purpose — per-template trust would let a repo shadow a trusted global template name and auto-run.

- internal/setup/runner.go
- internal/clone/clone.go
- internal/worktree/worktree.go
- internal/config/config.go

## skipped-stage-skips-its-dependents  (gotcha, verified)
Rendered stage jobs carry no status-check function in their `if:`, so a preflight-skipped stage silently skips every stage that needs it — only bulwark is guarded.

- internal/repogov/pipeline.go
- internal/repogov/templates/workflows/*-orchestration.yml.tmpl
- tests/repogov_pipeline_test.go

## update-check-cancelled-but-marked-checked  (gotcha, verified)
The background update check gets ~50ms, not its 3s timeout, and records LastCheckedAt even when the context cancelled it — suppressing retries for 24h.

- cmd/gt/main.go
- internal/config/config.go

## userfromenvrc-regex-couples-to-envrccontent  (gotcha, verified)
envrcUserPattern is an independent literal copy of the GH_TOKEN line EnvrcContent renders; drift makes set-auth start prompting for an identity it already knows.

- internal/setauth/setauth.go
- tests/setauth_test.go
- agentic/skills/use-gt/SKILL.md

## wt-add-from-ignored-when-branch-exists  (gotcha, verified)
gt wt add --from is silently a no-op when a local branch <type>/<name> already exists — the worktree attaches to the stale branch instead.
